answer_1.quote: The Diagram-Driven Course Questions Generation (DDCQG) task aims to generate a pedagogically appropriate question q given a diagram d, an input text t, and a course text c specifically.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using the pycocoevalcap package to measure alignment between generated and ground truth questions.

answer_4.quote: A separate group of subject annotators evaluated all samples based on their educational utility using a 100-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Samples scoring below the threshold were filtered out.
